ripples_hud.resolve_bar.desc:
Attack non-passive targets with your Stand to build up Resolve meter. %s
When the meter is full, you can enter True Resolve mode, which, in addition to the damage resistance, temporarily disables low stamina debuffs.
ripples_hud.resolve_bar.desc1.regular: Higher Resolve gives resistance to all damage, up to 60%.
ripples_hud.stamina_bar.desc:
Stamina is spent on Stand abilities, and regenerates when the Stand is idle or is unsummoned.
%s

ripples_hud.stamina_bar.desc1.resolve: During True Resolve, your Stand does not weaker from low stamina.
ripples_hud.stand_finisher.desc:
Using regular punches or barraging someone builds up the finisher meter, which is spent to make the heavy attack faster.
When the first (white) bar is full, your heavy attack is replaced with a special finisher attack.
ripples_hud.stand_range.desc:
If you move your Stand beyond its effective range, it gets weaker.
As a rule of thumb, stronger Stands have much lower range, which limits their high power to melee combat.

jojo_ripples.stand_stat.strength.desc: Affects the physical damage from the Stand's attacks and, to a lesser extent, damage resistance from other Stand attacks.
jojo_ripples.stand_stat.speed.desc: Affects the Stand's attack speed, movement speed, projectile fire rate, and barrage hit count.
jojo_ripples.stand_stat.range.desc: Combines effective range - the maximum range at which the Stand doesn't lose its strength, and the maximum range, beyond which the Stand cannot move at all.
jojo_ripples.stand_stat.durability.desc: Affects the stamina total and the Stand's damage resistance from other Stand attacks.
jojo_ripples.stand_stat.precision.desc: Increases the aiming capabilities of the Stand punches and projectile accuracy.
jojo_ripples.stand_stat.dev_potential.de: Shows how much more applications of the Stand's abilities this character is yet to discover. As the user learns more Stand skills, this stat decreases.

jojo_ripples.skill.punch.desc: A repeatable combo of fast and precise punches.
jojo_ripples.skill.barrage.desc: An extremely fast flurry of jabs.
jojo_ripples.skill.heavy_punch.desc: A slower punch, dealing more damage and knockback.
jojo_ripples.skill.heavy_charged.desc: A mighty charged attack, with immense damage and knockback.
jojo_ripples.skill.bearing_shot.desc: Fire a small bearing projectile with your Stand.

stand.jojo_ripples.star_platinum.desc: A power-type Stand with exceptionally high physical strength, speed and precision. Being the same type of Stand as The World, in a clash against it Star Platinum also awakens an ability to stop time.
stand.jojo_ripples.star_platinum.desc.no: A power-type Stand with exceptionally high physical strength, speed and precision.
jojo_ripples.skill.uppercut.desc: A faster heavy attack variation that breaks guard and knocks the enemy upwards.
jojo_ripples.skill.star_finger.desc: Star Platinum concentrates its strength in its middle and index fingers and extends them to a great length to deal damage at a higher distance. This can be performed even if Star Platinum is immobilized.
jojo_ripples.skill.inhale.desc: By inhaling the air with superhuman lung capacity, Star Platinum can pull entities in front of it towards itself.
jojo_ripples.skill.time_stop.desc: Star Platinum stops the flow of time for a brief moment, allowing only you to act freely while time is frozen.
jojo_ripples.skill.star_platinum.time_st: Star Platinum stops the flow of time for a brief moment, allowing only you to act freely while time is frozen.
jojo_ripples.skill.the_world.time_stop.d: The World stops the flow of time for a brief moment, allowing only you to act freely while time is frozen.
jojo_ripples.skill.time_resume.desc: Resume the flow of time during your own stopped time.
jojo_ripples.skill.time_resume.controls: Special ability wheel during Time Stop
jojo_ripples.skill.ts_punch.desc: The World strikes during stopped time with enough force to break through an opponent's stopped-time resistance.
stand.jojo_ripples.hierophant_green.desc: A long-range Stand with average physical strength, more suitable for reconnaissance than for close combat. Its body can unravel into tendrils, allowing the user to set up traps.
stand.jojo_ripples.mr_president.desc: A turtle-bound Stand that creates a hidden room inside Coco Jumbo's shell. Falling targets enter the room while the key is inserted, and pulling the key out locks the room.
stand.jojo_ripples.crazy_diamond.desc: One of the more physically strong power-type Stands, Crazy Diamond's ability is fixing objects and people. This ability has a multitude of various uses and makes the Stand very versatile, however, Crazy Diamond cannot heal the user's own wounds or cure any diseases.
jojo_ripples.skill.hit_armor_fix.desc: Crazy Diamond's heavy punch tears off a chunk of the target's armor, and fixes it back together to bring the target back to the melee range.
jojo_ripples.skill.disfiguring_punch.des: After a finisher punch, incorrectly restore the attacked body part. This partially heals the injury, but leaves the target unable to correctly control that body part for a short period of time.
jojo_ripples.skill.leave_object.desc: After punching a hole in the target's abdomen, leave a held item inside of them and partially heal the injury. Some items have special effects.
jojo_ripples.skill.repair_item.desc: Revert a broken item to its original undamaged state. Any enchantments on the item are also reverted.
jojo_ripples.skill.repair_item.controls: Hold special ability with a repairable item in the offhand
jojo_ripples.skill.uncraft.desc: Revert an item into the original component(s) it was crafted or smelted from.

hamon.breathing_stat.desc3: Уровень тренировки будет медленно уменьшаться, если вы перестанете выполнять упражнения!

hamon.control_stat.desc: Определяет максимальное количество энергии Хамона и эффективность способностей Хамона. Тренируется использованием способностей Хамона.

hamon.intro.about.name: О Хамоне
hamon.intro.about.text: In JJBA, Hamon is a form of energy produced by trained fighters via breathing. This energy has properties similar to sunlight's, making it fatal to zombies, vampires, and Pillar Men. In this mod it is one of the unique powers you can get.
hamon.intro.breath.name: Дыхание Хамона
hamon.intro.breath.text1: Чтобы эффективно использовать Хамон, вам нужно следить за своим дыханием, отображённым %s в левом верхнем углу.
hamon.intro.breath.text2: Все способности Хамона, такие как Овердрайв, исцеление, и любые другие открытые вами навыки, расходуют %s.
hamon.intro.breath.text3: Энергия наполняется путём использования особой %s, которая по умолчанию установлена на среднюю кнопку мыши.
hamon.intro.breath.text4: Прозрачная часть полоски энергии отображает %s. Если вы не будете восполнять энергию Хамона, вместо неё способности будут тратить стабильность дыхания. Это делает ваш Хамон слабее и временно уменьшает максимальное количество энергии.
hamon.intro.breath.text5: Если вы будете внимательно следить за энергией вашего Хамона, об этом не нужно будет беспокоиться.
hamon.intro.stats_transition: Чтобы стать сильным воином Хамона, нужно пройти необходимые тренировки. Следующая вкладка отображает ваши характеристики Хамона и объясняет процесс тренировки.
hamon.meditation_button: Нажмите здесь, чтобы начать медитацию (медитация остановится, если начать двигаться)
hamon.meditation_button.stability_hint: Во время медитации стабильность дыхания восстанавливается быстрее
hamon.next_point.control: Следующее очко навыка на %s уровне контроля Хамона
hamon.next_point.strength: Следующее очко навыка на %s уровне силы Хамона
hamon.reset_creative_only: Сбросить навыки на этой вкладке (только для творческого режима)
hamon.skills.attractant_repellent.desc: Удерживающий и отталкивающий Хамон - два противоположных типа, у каждого из которых есть свои способы применения.
hamon.skills.body_manipulation.desc: Энергия Хамона может воздействовать на живые организмы созданием вибраций воды внутри их тел.
hamon.skills.flexibility.desc: Hamon can help its user exceed the limits of their movement capabilities and attack range.
hamon.skills.infusion.desc: Разные материалы можно наполнить энергией Хамона. Living organisms can retain the energy for a longer time.
hamon.skills.life.desc: Энергия Хамона может ускорить регенерацию живого организма.
hamon.skills.overdrive.desc: Самое простое применение Хамона. Пользователь проводит энергию Хамона через свои кулаки, нанося урон либо прямой атакой, либо передавая эту энергию через твёрдый материал или жидкость.
hamon.stat_limited: Чтобы увеличить уровень дальше, сначала нужно повысить уровень тренировки дыхания
hamon_skill.toast.title: Изучите новый навык Хамона!
hamon.strength_skills.tab.desc: Skills suited for direct combat: various ways of dealing Hamon damage or increasing your mobility. For each 5 levels of Hamon Strength you get a skill point to learn a skill from this tab.
hamon.strength_stat.desc: Определяет мощность ваших атак Хамона. Тренируется использованием атак Хамона.
hamon.technique.no_reset_warning: Выбирайте тщательно! Выбранную технику нельзя будет сбросить, единственный способ - бросить тренировки Хамона и начать заново.
hamon.technique.no_reset_warning.2_tmp: Обратите внимание на то, что некоторые из навыков будут переработаны (обозначено как WIP).
hamon.technique.skill_buff1: Эта техника также повысит эффективность следующих навыков Хамона:

hamon.technique_slot.locked: Откроется на %s уровне силы Хамона и контроля Хамона
hamon.techniques.tab.desc: Techniques are sets of skills specific to certain characters from parts 1 and 2 of JJBA. %sNew technique skills are unlocked at certain levels of both Hamon Strength and Hamon Control.
hamon.techniques.tab.desc.only_one: Вы можете выбрать только одну технику (ряд из 3 навыков).
hamon.techniques_locked: Навыки техник откроются на %s уровне силы Хамона и контроля Хамона
hamon.training_bonus: Бонусные %s очков за предыдущие дни тренировок подряд
hamon.unspent_points: У вас есть неиспользованные очки навыков, используйте их для изучения новых навыков Хамона!
hamon.unspent_points_no_teacher: You have unspent skill points, visit a Hamon teacher to learn new Hamon skills from them!
hamonSkill.afterimages.desc: Speed Boost ability gives stronger effects. Leap's strength is increased. Maximum speed boost summons the user's afterimages.
hamonSkill.afterimages.name: Мастерство управления телом (WIP)
hamonSkill.animal_infusion.desc: Allows the user to charge living mobs and players with Hamon.
hamonSkill.animal_infusion.name: Насыщение живых организмов
hamonSkill.arrow_infusion.desc: Projectiles the user shoots, like arrows, knives and tridents, inflict additional Hamon damage.
hamonSkill.arrow_infusion.name: Насыщение стрел
hamonSkill.bubble_barrier.desc: Shoot a large-sized bubble, which traps its target for a few seconds.
hamonSkill.bubble_barrier.name: Bubble Barrier
hamonSkill.bubble_cutter.desc: Shoot out disc-shaped bubbles, which move at a high velocity. Gliding variation bubbles are more precise and, instead of hitting the ground, continue to glide above it.
hamonSkill.bubble_cutter.name: Мыльный резак
hamonSkill.bubble_launcher.desc: Shoot a barrage of Hamon-charged bubbles.
hamonSkill.bubble_launcher.name: Пузырькомёт
hamonSkill.cheat_death.desc:
When you are about to die, you will avoid death and gain Invisibility effect (once an in-game day).
Your next words: "What does it have to do with Hamon?"
hamonSkill.cheat_death.name: Обман смерти
hamonSkill.clacker_volley.desc: Allows you to use a pair of clackers as a Hamon-infused melee weapon or charge and throw it at the opponent at high speed.
hamonSkill.clacker_volley.name: Залп шаров (WIP)
hamonSkill.crimson_bubble.desc: После смерти вы помещаете всю вашу жизненную энергию (очки силы и контроля Хамона) в пузырь, из которого она может быть передана другому пользователю Хамона.
hamonSkill.crimson_bubble.name: Алый пузырь
hamonSkill.deep_pass.desc: После смерти вы передаёте всю вашу жизненную энергию (очки силы и контроля Хамона) ближайшему пользователю Хамона.
hamonSkill.deep_pass.name: Овердрайв спасения
hamonSkill.detector.desc: Gives entities around the user Glowing effect.
hamonSkill.detector.name: Detector
hamonSkill.expel_venom.desc: The user's Healing ability also removes Poison, Hunger, Wither and Nausea effects.
hamonSkill.expel_venom.name: Изгнание яда
hamonSkill.hamon_cutter.desc: Infuse a bottle of liquid with Hamon and shoot the liquid out at high speed. In addition to Hamon damage, the potion's effect is applied to the target.
hamonSkill.hamon_cutter.name: Режущий Хамон
hamonSkill.hamon_shock.desc: The user applies a Hamon charge directly to a living creature's head, incapacitating them for a short time. The shock wears off if the target takes damage.
hamonSkill.hamon_shock.name: Hamon Shock
hamonSkill.hamon_spread.desc: Whenever the user attack an undead with Hamon, it continues spreading through the target's body, weakening it and slowing down its regeneration.
hamonSkill.hamon_spread.name: Распространение Хамона
hamonSkill.healing.name: Исцеление
hamonSkill.healing_touch.desc: Allows the user to heal others with Healing ability while sneaking.
hamonSkill.healing_touch.name: Целительное касание
hamonSkill.hypnosis.desc: The user temporarily tames a tameable animal.
hamonSkill.hypnosis.name: Гипноз животных
hamonSkill.jump.desc: Allows the user to leap forward by jumping while sneaking.
hamonSkill.jump.name: Прыжок
hamonSkill.life_magnetism.desc: Превращает блок листьев в планер. Если не заряжать планер энергией Хамона, он распадётся.
hamonSkill.life_magnetism.name: Биомагнетизм
hamonSkill.liquid_walking.desc: Allows the user to freely walk on a liquid surface. Press double Shift to disable.
hamonSkill.liquid_walking.name: Ходьба по жидкостям
hamonSkill.metal_silver_overdrive.desc:
You can perform Overdrive attack with a weapon or a tool.
Without a weapon, the regular Overdrive deals more damage to targets with armor or an equipped melee weapon.
hamonSkill.metal_silver_overdrive.name: Металлический серебряный Овердрайв
hamonSkill.natural_talent.desc: Ваша тренировка Хамона быстрее в 2 раза.
hamonSkill.natural_talent.name: Natural Talent
hamonSkill.overdrive.desc: The user's unarmed punches deal additional Hamon damage. Hamon is especially effective against undead creatures.
hamonSkill.overdrive.name: Овердрайв
hamonSkill.overdrive_barrage.desc: You unleash a barrage of rapid Overdrive attacks.
hamonSkill.overdrive_barrage.name: Шквальный Овердрайв
hamonSkill.overdrive_strong.desc: Shift variation - Hamon Beat - is a stronger attack with extra knockback.
hamonSkill.plant_infusion.desc: The user temporarily charges a block of a plant with Hamon. While it's charged, mobs and players will take Hamon damage upon touching it.
hamonSkill.plant_infusion.name: Насыщение растений (блок)
hamonSkill.plant_item_infusion.desc: When throwing out a plant, the user charges it with Hamon. Mobs and players getting too close to it will take Hamon damage.
hamonSkill.plant_item_infusion.name: Насыщение растений (предмет)
hamonSkill.plants_growth.desc: The Healing ability can apply bone meal effect.
hamonSkill.plants_growth.name: Рост растений
hamonSkill.projectile_shield.desc: Creates a projectile reflecting barrier in front of the user.
hamonSkill.projectile_shield.name: Барьер от снарядов
hamonSkill.protection.desc: Creates a Hamon-charged coating on the surface of the user's body, reducing the incoming physical damage.
hamonSkill.protection.name: Отражающий Хамон
hamonSkill.rebuff_overdrive.desc: Вы встаёте в защитную стойку и делаете взмах обоими локтями. Если после этого вас атакуют в ближнем бою в определённый промежуток времени, ваш удар парирует эту атаку, наносит сокрушительный урон Хамоном и откидывает цель назад.
hamonSkill.rebuff_overdrive.name: Овердрайв отпора
hamonSkill.rope_trap.desc: Right-clicking a string temporarily turns connected strings into a Hamon-charged cobweb. While sneaking, you automatically place a string from your hotbar.
hamonSkill.rope_trap.name: Rope Trap (WIP)
hamonSkill.satiporoja_scarf.desc: You get a scarf which, when worn, reduces Hamon energy spent and absorbs Hamon damage. You can use it as a Hamon-conductive melee weapon or swing it to cover a larger area of targets.
hamonSkill.satiporoja_scarf.name: Шарф из жуков Сатипороджа (WIP)
hamonSkill.scarlet_overdrive.desc: A special type of Sunlight Yellow Overdrive attack that sets the target on fire.
hamonSkill.scarlet_overdrive.name: Алый Овердрайв
hamonSkill.sendo_overdrive.desc:
Applying this attack to a wall or floor creates a wave of Hamon energy, which damages mobs and players in the area.
When used on the floor, this creates a narrower wave, or, when the attack is charged for longer, an area of effect.
hamonSkill.sendo_overdrive.name: Овердрайв Сэндо
hamonSkill.sendo_wave_kick.desc: You charge forward, hitting all enemies on your way with your knee, additionally dealing Hamon damage to them.
hamonSkill.sendo_wave_kick.name: Волновой удар Сэндо
hamonSkill.snake_muffler.desc: When getting attacked while wearing the scarf, you jump over the attacker using the scarf and deal Hamon damage to them (has a cooldown). Attacking with the scarf while sneaking ensnares the target.
hamonSkill.snake_muffler.name: Шарф-змея (WIP)
hamonSkill.speed_boost.desc: Gives the user Speed and Haste effects for a short amount of time.
hamonSkill.speed_boost.name: Ускорение
hamonSkill.sunlight_yellow_overdrive.des: A Hamon-charged heavy blow. By charging the attack for longer, the user can channel more Hamon energy into the punch to deal a lot of damage.
hamonSkill.syo_barrage.desc: A more powerful variation of Overdrive Barrage, followed by a devastating finishing punch. Takes a few seconds to charge.
hamonSkill.syo_barrage.name: Sunlight Yellow Overdrive Barrage (WIP)
hamonSkill.throwables_infusion.desc: Snowballs, eggs and splash water bottles the user throws inflict additional Hamon damage.
hamonSkill.throwables_infusion.name: Насыщение снарядов
hamonSkill.tornado_overdrive.desc: By spinning at high speed, you deal Hamon damage to the enemies around you. This attack is especially deadly while falling.
hamonSkill.tornado_overdrive.name: Овердрайв-торнадо
hamonSkill.turquoise_blue_overdrive.desc: While underwater, the user can transfer a powerful wave of Hamon energy through water.
hamonSkill.turquoise_blue_overdrive.name: Подводный бирюзовый Овердрайв
hamonSkill.wall_climbing.desc: Lets the user adhere to a vertical surface and climb it.
hamonSkill.wall_climbing.name: Лазание по стенам
hamonSkill.zoom_punch.desc: Extends the user's arm, allowing them to punch an enemy from longer distance, additionally dealing Hamon damage.
hamonSkill.zoom_punch.name: Приближающийся удар
